competing_hypotheses.claim: The 233.46M XRP theft creates a potential future supply overhang if the attacker moves or sells it.
support: TRM and Bitquery report approximately 233.5M XRP moved to the same receiver.
Bitquery observed no outgoing transaction through 03:54 UTC.
counter: No sale or exchange deposit was confirmed by that cutoff.
The receiver's later disposition is unknown.
On-chain transfer alone does not establish sell intent.

competing_hypotheses.claim: Binance customer XRP reserve coverage may have been impaired if one of the five stolen source wallets was included in the October 1 XRP proof-of-reserves wallet set.
support: Five Binance-attributed XRPL wallets lost 233.46M native XRP.
October 1 secondary reporting placed Binance XRP reserve ratio near 100.77%.
counter: The five source wallet addresses and XRP-BF2 reserve address have not been cross-referenced.
CoinDesk's Binance 14 reserve-wallet finding concerns Ethereum, not XRPL.
Binance says it will cover all losses; replenishment not yet independently measured.

competing_hypotheses.claim: Reported positive October 29 spot ETF flows may coexist with falling XRP spot prices because ETF demand is not the only marginal price-setting flow.
support: Alpha Finance reports +$8.4M across five spot funds for October 29.
OKX venue-specific snapshot at 03:41 UTC showed XRP down 5.41% over 24 hours.
counter: TheXRPInvestor mixes spot, derivative and index products and has a product-count mismatch.
The market quote is stale and venue-specific; no synchronized global spot panel.
